# Repositorio Académico - Universidad de Chile

> > Open-access institutional repository preserving and disseminating academic research, theses, and publications from Universidad de Chile.

Repositorio Académico is the official digital archive of Universidad de Chile, managed by SISIB (Sistema de Servicios de Información Bibliotecarios). It provides comprehensive access to graduate theses, undergraduate research, faculty publications, and institutional records across all academic disciplines at the university.

## Core Access & Discovery

- [Homepage](https://repositorio.uchile.cl): Main entry point for Universidad de Chile academic repository with thesis and publications
- [Advanced Search](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/discover): Advanced search interface for discovering academic publications and theses
- [Browse by Issue Date](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/browse): Chronological browsing interface for institutional repository contents

## Submission & Publishing

- [How to Publish](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/page/comoPublicar): Publication guidelines and document submission procedures
- [Submit Publications](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/page/envia_libros): Guidelines for submitting publications to Repositorio Académico

## Information & Support

- [About](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/page/acerca): About Repositorio Académico Universidad de Chile and open-access mission
- [Help & Documentation](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/page/ayuda): Help documentation and getting started guide for repository users
- [Contact](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/page/contacto): Contact information for Repositorio Académico and SISIB services

## Faculty Collections

- [Facultad de Arquitectura y Urbanismo](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100000): Faculty collection of architecture and urban planning theses
- [Facultad de Artes](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100001): Faculty collection of arts research and academic publications
- [Facultad de Ciencias](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100002): Faculty collection of sciences research and graduate theses
- [Facultad de Ciencias Agronómicas](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100003): Faculty collection of agronomy and agricultural research publications
- [Facultad de Ciencias Físicas y Matemáticas](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100004): Faculty collection of physics, mathematics and computer science theses
- [Facultad de Ciencias Forestales y de la Conservación de la Naturaleza](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100005): Faculty collection of forestry and environmental conservation research
- [Facultad de Ciencias Químicas y Farmacéuticas](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100006): Faculty collection of chemical and pharmaceutical sciences research
- [Facultad de Ciencias Sociales](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100007): Faculty collection of social sciences theses and academic research
- [Facultad de Ciencias Veterinarias y Pecuarias](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100008): Faculty collection of veterinary and animal sciences research
- [Facultad de Comunicación e Imagen](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/100015): Faculty collection of communication and media studies theses

## Optional

- [Consejo Universitario](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/137451): University governance meeting minutes and institutional records
- [Consejo de Evaluación](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/170411): Evaluation council institutional records and academic publications
